description: Source code for a Direct3D 11 H.264 video accelerator implementation for Windows, handling decoding, buffer management, and picture output within the Chromium media framework.

classes.name: D3D11H264Picture
classes.description: Represents an H264 picture buffer with D3D11 integration, managing picture reference and usage state.

classes.name: D3D11H264Accelerator
classes.description: Implements H264 decoding acceleration using Direct3D 11, managing buffer submission, decoding, and output.

methods.name: AppendSubsamples
methods.description: Converts subsample entries to D3D11 video decoder subsample mapping blocks.

methods.name: CreateH264Picture
methods.description: Creates a new D3D11H264Picture object wrapping a picture buffer.

methods.name: SubmitFrameMetadata
methods.description: Submits frame metadata including SPS, PPS, DPB, and reference pictures for decoding.

methods.name: RetrieveBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the next available bitstream buffer for decoding.

methods.name: FillPicParamsWithConstants
methods.description: Fills picture parameters with constant values required for decoding.

methods.name: PicParamsFromSPS
methods.description: Populates picture parameters from SPS data.

methods.name: PicParamsFromPPS
methods.description: Populates picture parameters from PPS data.

methods.name: PicParamsFromSliceHeader
methods.description: Populates picture parameters from slice header data.

methods.name: PicParamsFromPic
methods.description: Populates picture parameters from a specific picture object.

methods.name: SubmitSlice
methods.description: Submits a slice of video data for decoding, including buffer management and parameter setup.

methods.name: SubmitSliceData
methods.description: Submits accumulated slice data buffers to the decoder.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Finalizes decoding of a picture and submits it.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder buffers and state.

methods.name: OutputPicture
methods.description: Outputs a decoded picture to the client.

methods.name: RecordFailure
methods.description: Logs and records a decoding failure with reason and error code.

methods.name: SetVideoDecoder
methods.description: Sets the current video decoder instance.
